description: Bulk import contacts into Brevo (POST /contacts/import). Required: one of jsonBody (array of { email, attributes }), fileBody (CSV text with header) or fileUrl. Optional: listIds, updateExistingContacts (default true), emptyContactsAttributes, notifyUrl, newList ({ listName, folderId }). Returns a process id (get_brevo_process).

emptyContactsAttributes.description: Clear existing attributes that are empty in the import

fileBody.description: Contacts to import as CSV text with header row

fileUrl.description: URL of a file with the contacts to import

jsonBody.description: Contacts to import as [{ email, attributes }]

newList.description: Create a new list for the imported contacts: { listName, folderId }

notifyUrl.description: URL notified when the import has finished

updateExistingContacts.description: Update contacts that already exist (default true)

name: import_brevo_contacts
